subject: social_studies
concept: Reflecting on and articulating one's own emerging personal ethical framework, informed by the frameworks studied
source_inspiration: original content, connecting to the Wisdom and Agency Pillars — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student reviews the frameworks studied and identifies which resonate most with their own thinking
exercise.abstract: Student writes a personal reflection on which ethical considerations matter most to them and why, referencing at least one studied framework

assessment.mastery_threshold: reflection genuinely references at least one studied framework in relation to the student's own thinking
misconception_flags: reflection is generic and doesn't connect to any actual framework studied in this unit

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
